sources.snippet: Overview Gemma-4-31B-StyleTune is a surgical finetuned variant of Google's Gemma 4 31B model created by Gryphe. The model modifies exactly one tensor—the lm_head output projection layer—while freezing all 60 transformer layers, attention heads, and MLPs completely untouched.
